An annual increment of 4%, 7% or 10% of the monthly consolidated retainership fee is given based on performance during the year. | Outstation Young Professionals will be provided company accommodation, subject to availability: 2-bedroom accommodation, or an equivalent monthly rent of Rs. 6,000 at city location. YP-3 may also be considered for 3-bedroom accommodation, or an equivalent monthly rent of Rs. 10,000 at city location. Charges towards electricity, water, maintenance etc. will be applicable as per actuals. No HRA will be payable. During the initial three (3) months, outstation Young Professionals may be allowed to stay at the SAIL Guest House/Transit House on payment of Rs. 200/- per day, subject to availability. Food charges will be at applicable rates. | Mobile phone/broadband expenses (including monthly call charges, monthly rental and applicable taxes) for official use are paid within the following monthly ceiling. | Free medical facilities (OPD & IPD) are available at a Company-owned Hospital at any Plant/Unit location for self, spouse and two (2) dependent children. Young Professionals at city locations may be paid OPD medical expenses for self and spouse (combined) as per the limits below. No medical referral facility will be extended. It is mandatory to have adequate self-insurance cover (Medical/Life/Health/Accident). | These reimbursements are subject to documentary proof and are adjusted on a pro-rata basis for any period less than one year/month, as applicable. | Travel by road is allowed only with prior approval of the Competent Authority, with road mileage reimbursed at Rs. 10.50 per km. Air travel for YP-2 is allowed for distances more than 500 km. At metro locations (Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata, Chennai, Hyderabad and Bangalore), a 15% increase in the above limits applies. Stay expenses are reimbursed on production of a hotel/guest house receipt or bill, within prescribed limits.

selection_process: The notification describes a scrutiny stage followed by an interview
with a test in some cases
depending on how many applications are received.
Applications received by the closing date are scrutinised for fulfilment of the eligibility criteria. If the applications against an engagement are more than five (5) times the requirement
a Computer-based/Aptitude/General Management/Psychometric Test may be organised

or applicants may be asked to appear in any standard test/exam. Candidates are then shortlisted for personal interaction/interview in the ratio of 1:3 based on performance in the prescribed test. If more than one candidate obtains the cut-off marks
all of them will be called for interview. If fewer than five (5) times the requirement is received
all candidates may be called for personal interview. Candidates selected for engagement must join as indicated in the Offer of Engagement.
The CBT/Personal Interview will be held at centres across the country as decided by the management. The examination centre allotted is binding
and no request for a change of centre
interview date or medical examination date will be entertained.
Candidates attending the interview are reimbursed a single to-and-fro AC 2-Tier rail fare (with reservation and Tatkal charges
if any) from the place of correspondence address to the venue by the shortest route
on production of proof of journey
provided the distance by rail or road is more than 30 km each way. For candidates travelling by a higher class or by road
reimbursement is restricted to the fare of the entitled class. On joining
YP-1 and YP-2 are reimbursed an amount equivalent to 2AC train fare from the nearest railway station. YP-3 is entitled to economy airfare or 1AC train fare from the nearest railway station/airport.
how_to_apply: Eligible candidates must apply online only through SAIL's website, www.sail.co.in (Careers). No other mode of application is accepted. Candidates click on the link of the engagement they are applying for and submit the information in the appropriate fields.
The notification lists the following steps. These are indicative, and candidates must follow the steps displayed on the online screen.
Go to the SAIL "Careers" page at www.sail.co.in or http://sailcareers.com.
Read the advertisement carefully to be sure about eligibility.
Go through the User Manual available on the site and follow the steps mentioned.
Click on "Login" or "Apply".
New users must complete the one-time registration first, then go to "Registered User" and proceed with the User ID and Password.
Fill in the required information and upload the photograph, signature and the required certificates/documents.
Review the details entered and confirm. Once confirmed, no editing is allowed.
Pay the Registration and/or Processing Fee online. The payment link is available after the application is completed, and the candidate bears the payment charges in addition to the fee.
Submit the application and take a printout of the application showing the Application ID.
After applying, candidates must download the system-generated Registration Slip with the Application ID and keep it for future reference.
Read the online instructions carefully before submitting the application.

Admission at all stages is provisional and subject to meeting the eligibility criteria, which are verified at the time of interview and joining. Candidature is cancelled if any criterion is not met or valid documentary proof cannot be produced.
Joining is subject to a general medical fitness certificate from a qualified/authorised medical practitioner. The Company may also ask for a medical examination as per applicable standards.
Candidates need a valid personal e-mail ID and a working mobile number that remain active until the entire selection process is complete.
It is in the candidate's interest to apply for only one engagement.
Scanned copies of original documents must be uploaded as PDF files, with each file not more than 300 KB. The list below applies to YP-1, YP-2 and YP-3.
Matriculation certificate showing date of birth
Pass certificate of XII, B.E./B.Tech/MBA/M.E./M.Tech./PhD/any other qualification of relevant discipline
Experience certificate(s) from the employer showing relevant post-qualification experience
NOC from the present employer, if employed under PSUs/Autonomous Bodies/Govt. Department
Photo identity proof (Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Passport or Voter ID)
Address proof (Voter ID, Driving License, Aadhaar Card or others)
Conversion certificate/chart/formula for CGPA/SGPA to percentage (if available, optional)

Incomplete applications, applications without photograph, signature or required documents, and applications not meeting the eligibility criteria will be summarily rejected. The decision of SAIL, CMO/EMD on eligibility, acceptance, rejection and issue of call letters is final and binding. No request for editing payment details or issue of admit card will be entertained in wrong-submission cases.

All correspondence is by e-mail/SMS only. Information about the examination, interview, admit card, CBT result, call letters and final selection is shared by e-mail/SMS or uploaded on the SAIL website. Candidates are allowed to appear in the CBT/interview only with a valid admit card/call letter carrying an identifiable photograph.

content_sections.heading: SAIL Young Professional Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: All Indian nationals who have completed 23 years of age and possess the required educational or professional qualifications and work experience can apply. The notification states that the minimum age for this engagement is 23 years. Essential qualifications must be Regular/Full-time in the respective stream from a University/Institution recognised by UGC/AICTE/ICAI/ICMAI. The experience must be from a PSU, a Govt. organisation, a Public Limited Company, a JV of PSUs, or a private firm with a valid CIN. The upper age limit, essential qualification and post-qualification experience are reckoned as on 15.10.2026. Where a University/Institution prescribes CGPA instead of percentage, the CGPA is converted to an equivalent percentage as per that institution's norms. If no norms are specified, it is converted proportionately (for example, 8.3 out of 10 is treated as 83%). Candidates must produce a copy of these conversion norms at the time of interview. Candidates employed in Govt. Departments/PSUs/Autonomous Bodies must produce an original NOC from their employer at the time of interview and a Release Order at the time of joining.

content_sections.text: The age limit depends on the grade. The upper age limit is 35 years for YP-1, 38 years for YP-2 and 42 years for YP-3, reckoned as on 15.10.2026. The minimum age is 23 years. Age relaxation for reserved categories is not specified in the notification.

content_sections.heading: SAIL Young Professional Salary
content_sections.text: Young Professionals are paid a monthly consolidated retainership fee based on their grade. An annual increment of 4%, 7% or 10% of the monthly consolidated retainership fee is given based on performance during the year. Outstation Young Professionals will be provided company accommodation, subject to availability: 2-bedroom accommodation, or an equivalent monthly rent of Rs. 6,000 at city location. YP-3 may also be considered for 3-bedroom accommodation, or an equivalent monthly rent of Rs. 10,000 at city location. Charges towards electricity, water, maintenance etc. will be applicable as per actuals. No HRA will be payable. During the initial three (3) months, outstation Young Professionals may be allowed to stay at the SAIL Guest House/Transit House on payment of Rs. 200/- per day, subject to availability. Food charges will be at applicable rates. Mobile phone/broadband expenses (including monthly call charges, monthly rental and applicable taxes) for official use are paid within the following monthly ceiling. Free medical facilities (OPD & IPD) are available at a Company-owned Hospital at any Plant/Unit location for self, spouse and two (2) dependent children. Young Professionals at city locations may be paid OPD medical expenses for self and spouse (combined) as per the limits below. No medical referral facility will be extended. It is mandatory to have adequate self-insurance cover (Medical/Life/Health/Accident). These reimbursements are subject to documentary proof and are adjusted on a pro-rata basis for any period less than one year/month, as applicable. Travel by road is allowed only with prior approval of the Competent Authority, with road mileage reimbursed at Rs. 10.50 per km. Air travel for YP-2 is allowed for distances more than 500 km. At metro locations (Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata, Chennai, Hyderabad and Bangalore), a 15% increase in the above limits applies. Stay expenses are reimbursed on production of a hotel/guest house receipt or bill, within prescribed limits.

content_sections.heading: SAIL Young Professional Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notification describes a scrutiny stage followed by an interview, with a test in some cases, depending on how many applications are received. Applications received by the closing date are scrutinised for fulfilment of the eligibility criteria. If the applications against an engagement are more than five (5) times the requirement, a Computer-based/Aptitude/General Management/Psychometric Test may be organised, or applicants may be asked to appear in any standard test/exam. Candidates are then shortlisted for personal interaction/interview in the ratio of 1:3 based on performance in the prescribed test. If more than one candidate obtains the cut-off marks, all of them will be called for interview. If fewer than five (5) times the requirement is received, all candidates may be called for personal interview. Candidates selected for engagement must join as indicated in the Offer of Engagement. The CBT/Personal Interview will be held at centres across the country as decided by the management. The examination centre allotted is binding, and no request for a change of centre, interview date or medical examination date will be entertained. Candidates attending the interview are reimbursed a single to-and-fro AC 2-Tier rail fare (with reservation and Tatkal charges, if any) from the place of correspondence address to the venue by the shortest route, on production of proof of journey, provided the distance by rail or road is more than 30 km each way. For candidates travelling by a higher class or by road, reimbursement is restricted to the fare of the entitled class. On joining, YP-1 and YP-2 are reimbursed an amount equivalent to 2AC train fare from the nearest railway station. YP-3 is entitled to economy airfare or 1AC train fare from the nearest railway station/airport.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting the SAIL Young Professionals recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Steel Authority of India (SAIL), a premier Public Sector Undertaking under the Ministry of Steel, Government of India, for various divisions.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in SAIL Young Professionals Notification 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 11 vacancies have been announced for various Young Professional posts including Marketing, C&IT, Finance & Accounts, HR, and Environment Management.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the online application for SAIL recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form is 15-10-2026. Candidates are advised to apply well before the deadline to avoid network congestion.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for SAIL Young Professionals positions?
faq.answer: The educational qualification varies by post, ranging from B.E./B.Tech, Graduate degrees with MBA, to professional qualifications like CA or CMA along with required post-qualification experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary range offered for SAIL Young Professionals?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated monthly retainership fee ranging from Rs. 70,000/- to Rs. 1,40,000/- depending on the specific engagement level and post.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for applying to SAIL recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, an application and/or processing fee of Rs. 500/- is applicable for candidates applying under the Young Professionals YP-1, YP-2, and YP-3 categories.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit to apply for SAIL Young Professionals posts?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement is 23 years, while the maximum age limit ranges between 35 and 42 years depending upon the specific post applied for.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for SAIL Young Professionals?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises scrutiny of applications, followed by a computer-based aptitude/psychometric test if necessary, and a personal interview conducted in a 1:3 ratio.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the job location for SAIL Young Professionals recruitment?
faq.answer: The positions are primarily based at the Central Marketing Organisation and Environment Management Division located in Kolkata, West Bengal.

faq.question: Q10. How can candidates apply for SAIL Young Professionals recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online by visiting the official SAIL careers website at www.sail.co.in or http://sailcareers.com, completing registration, and submitting required documents.
